title: ASC 948 – Financial Services–Mortgage Banking
summary: Governs mortgage loans held for sale, interest rate lock commitments, and mortgage servicing rights for mortgage banking entities.
description: ASC 948 addresses measurement of mortgage loans held for sale, derivative treatment of interest rate lock commitments, forward loan sale commitments, and mortgage servicing rights with cross-references to ASC 860. No dedicated IFRS mortgage banking standard exists.

bannerNotice.title: No Direct IFRS Equivalent
bannerNotice.body: No dedicated IFRS mortgage banking standard exists. While general IFRS standards on financial instruments apply, ASC 948's specific mortgage banking guidance lacks a direct counterpart.
